units.rawText: Together with Persicaria and Sol, we entered the Helios Sector.

units.rawText: For safety's sake, let's test the comms environment around here.
units.displayText: For safety's sake, let's test the comms environment around here.

spans.text: For safety's sake, let's test the comms environment around here.

units.rawText: Professor, I'll be calling you now.
units.displayText: Professor, I'll be calling you now.

spans.text: Professor, I'll be calling you now.

units.rawText: Eh? Right now? Wait...
units.displayText: Eh? Right now? Wait...

spans.text: Eh? Right now? Wait...

units.rawText: Before I can finish, an exciting theme song from a late-night anime begins playing in my ear.
units.displayText: Before I can finish, an exciting theme song from a late-night anime begins playing in my ear.

spans.text: Before I can finish, an exciting theme song from a late-night anime begins playing in my ear.

units.rawText: Er, is that...your personalized ringtone, Professor?

spans.text: Er, is that...your personalized ringtone, Professor?

units.rawText: Uwah, the lyrics are so chuuni.
units.displayText: Uwah, the lyrics are so chuuni.

units.rawText: I, I think Croque changed it on her own!
units.displayText: I, I think Croque changed it on her own!

spans.text: I, I think Croque changed it on her own!

units.rawText: More importantly, is there any signal disruption?
units.displayText: More importantly, is there any signal disruption?

spans.text: More importantly, is there any signal disruption?

units.rawText: Nope, I'm not detecting any disruption. The signal's just fine.
units.displayText: Nope, I'm not detecting any disruption. The signal's just fine.

spans.text: Nope, I'm not detecting any disruption. The signal's just fine.

units.rawText: That's strange, then why couldn't you contact Croque? I'll give it a shot.
units.displayText: That's strange, then why couldn't you contact Croque? I'll give it a shot.

spans.text: That's strange, then why couldn't you contact Croque? I'll give it a shot.

units.rawText: What, it actually got through?
units.displayText: What, it actually got through?

spans.text: What, it actually got through?

units.rawText: Sol? Are you out of the training room? Why are you calling me all of a sudden?
units.displayText: Sol? Are you out of the training room? Why are you calling me all of a sudden?

spans.text: Sol? Are you out of the training room? Why are you calling me all of a sudden?

units.rawText: What do you mean, all of a sudden? Are you okay?
units.displayText: What do you mean, all of a sudden? Are you okay?

spans.text: What do you mean, all of a sudden? Are you okay?

units.rawText: That's what I mean by all of a sudden...
units.displayText: That's what I mean by all of a sudden...

spans.text: That's what I mean by all of a sudden...

units.rawText: I'm perfectly fine, why would I not be okay?
units.displayText: I'm perfectly fine, why would I not be okay?

spans.text: I'm perfectly fine, why would I not be okay?

units.rawText: Then you should have told us you were fine, everyone was frightened when they lost contact with you.
units.displayText: Then you should have told us you were fine, everyone was frightened when they lost contact with you.

spans.text: Then you should have told us you were fine, everyone was frightened when they lost contact with you.

units.rawText: I was focusing on training in the training room when Persicaria and the Prof suddenly yoinked me out without warning.
units.displayText: I was focusing on training in the training room when Persicaria and the Prof suddenly yoinked me out without warning.

spans.text: I was focusing on training in the training room when Persicaria and the Prof suddenly yoinked me out without warning.

units.rawText: The Prof said something might have happened to you, so I rushed over without even changing my pants!
units.displayText: The Prof said something might have happened to you, so I rushed over without even changing my pants!

spans.text: The Prof said something might have happened to you, so I rushed over without even changing my pants!

units.rawText: It's not that bad, is it... I know this is my first scouting mission, but am I really that unreliable?
units.displayText: It's not that bad, is it... I know this is my first scouting mission, but am I really that unreliable?

spans.text: It's not that bad, is it... I know this is my first scouting mission, but am I really that unreliable?

units.rawText: That's like, the most basic element of interpersonal trust... Am I some kind of weakling in your eyes?
units.displayText: That's like, the most basic element of interpersonal trust... Am I some kind of weakling in your eyes?

spans.text: That's like, the most basic element of interpersonal trust... Am I some kind of weakling in your eyes?

units.rawText: It's, uh, it's not like I'm saying you're weak or anything, it's just that something unexpected might have happened in the sector...
units.displayText: It's, uh, it's not like I'm saying you're weak or anything, it's just that something unexpected might have happened in the sector...

spans.text: It's, uh, it's not like I'm saying you're weak or anything, it's just that something unexpected might have happened in the sector...

units.rawText: That's even less possible. I checked already, this is a special experimental Svarog Heavy Industries sector.
units.displayText: That's even less possible. I checked already, this is a special experimental Svarog Heavy Industries sector.

spans.text: That's even less possible. I checked already, this is a special experimental Svarog Heavy Industries sector.

units.rawText: In fact, I'd say the chances of the machines here exploding are lower than me pulling an SSR in the gacha!
units.displayText: In fact, I'd say the chances of the machines here exploding are lower than me pulling an SSR in the gacha!

spans.text: In fact, I'd say the chances of the machines here exploding are lower than me pulling an SSR in the gacha!

units.rawText: Then why didn't you contact us after the call cut out?
units.displayText: Then why didn't you contact us after the call cut out?

spans.text: Then why didn't you contact us after the call cut out?

units.rawText: It's not that we don't trust you, but anyone would be worried if we suddenly lost contact with one of our explorers.
units.displayText: It's not that we don't trust you, but anyone would be worried if we suddenly lost contact with one of our explorers.

spans.text: It's not that we don't trust you, but anyone would be worried if we suddenly lost contact with one of our explorers.

units.rawText: This isn't a joke, you know.
units.displayText: This isn't a joke, you know.

spans.text: This isn't a joke, you know.

units.rawText: The call cut out? What are you talking about, Persicaria? When did I ever call you?
units.displayText: The call cut out? What are you talking about, Persicaria? When did I ever call you?

spans.text: The call cut out? What are you talking about, Persicaria? When did I ever call you?

units.rawText: Also, about that cutting out stuff... This is the first time I've heard from you ever since I left the Oasis.
units.displayText: Also, about that cutting out stuff... This is the first time I've heard from you ever since I left the Oasis.

spans.text: Also, about that cutting out stuff... This is the first time I've heard from you ever since I left the Oasis.

units.rawText: Croque's face on the monitor looks blank and confused, and her answer stuns us all.
units.displayText: Croque's face on the monitor looks blank and confused, and her answer stuns us all.

spans.text: Croque's face on the monitor looks blank and confused, and her answer stuns us all.

units.rawText: Upon seeing that Croque doesn't seem to be lying, Persicaria and I exchange looks.
units.displayText: Upon seeing that Croque doesn't seem to be lying, Persicaria and I exchange looks.

spans.text: Upon seeing that Croque doesn't seem to be lying, Persicaria and I exchange looks.

units.rawText: ...Give us your coordinates and stay where you are, we'll talk after we meet up.
units.displayText: ...Give us your coordinates and stay where you are, we'll talk after we meet up.

spans.text: ...Give us your coordinates and stay where you are, we'll talk after we meet up.

units.rawText: Hm. So you're saying that I was the one who initiated the call to you and the Professor.
units.displayText: Hm. So you're saying that I was the one who initiated the call to you and the Professor.

spans.text: Hm. So you're saying that I was the one who initiated the call to you and the Professor.

units.rawText: And then, the call cut out and you couldn't contact me no matter what you did. So you guys got worried and came straight here, is that it?
units.displayText: And then, the call cut out and you couldn't contact me no matter what you did. So you guys got worried and came straight here, is that it?

spans.text: And then, the call cut out and you couldn't contact me no matter what you did. So you guys got worried and came straight here, is that it?

units.rawText: Yup, that's it.
units.displayText: Yup, that's it.

spans.text: Yup, that's it.

units.rawText: No, that's not it.
units.displayText: No, that's not it.

spans.text: No, that's not it.

units.displayText: Croque shows us her phone.

spans.text: Croque shows us her phone.

units.rawText: But how...
units.displayText: But how...

spans.text: But how...

units.rawText: I'd like to know myself. I'm still organizing my information and I was planning to send it back after I was done.
units.displayText: I'd like to know myself. I'm still organizing my information and I was planning to send it back after I was done.

spans.text: I'd like to know myself. I'm still organizing my information and I was planning to send it back after I was done.

units.rawText: That can't be, you've already given us your report.
units.displayText: That can't be, you've already given us your report.

spans.text: That can't be, you've already given us your report.

units.displayText: Persicaria shows Croque her memo pad.

spans.text: Persicaria shows Croque her memo pad.

units.rawText: You said Helios Sector was just like you predicted before you set out, it was an energy-related experimental sector with ample stocks of operands.
units.displayText: You said Helios Sector was just like you predicted before you set out, it was an energy-related experimental sector with ample stocks of operands.

spans.text: You said Helios Sector was just like you predicted before you set out, it was an energy-related experimental sector with ample stocks of operands.

units.rawText: And there were very few Residents here... See, these are your own words.
units.displayText: And there were very few Residents here... See, these are your own words.

spans.text: And there were very few Residents here... See, these are your own words.

units.rawText: Now that's weird. Could this be some kind of occult incident?
units.displayText: Now that's weird. Could this be some kind of occult incident?

spans.text: Now that's weird. Could this be some kind of occult incident?

units.rawText: Maybe it was my doppelganger which contacted you...
units.displayText: Maybe it was my doppelganger which contacted you...

spans.text: Maybe it was my doppelganger which contacted you...

units.rawText: ...Hey! How did the occult get involved all of a sudden?!
units.displayText: ...Hey! How did the occult get involved all of a sudden?!

spans.text: ...Hey! How did the occult get involved all of a sudden?!

units.rawText: This is a world of science, don't just go roping in evil spirits and ghosts and whatever!
units.displayText: This is a world of science, don't just go roping in evil spirits and ghosts and whatever!

spans.text: This is a world of science, don't just go roping in evil spirits and ghosts and whatever!

units.rawText: You know, I was just mentioning it casually, so why are you so nervous and...

spans.text: You know, I was just mentioning it casually, so why are you so nervous and...

units.rawText: Ahem! Anyway, there are quite a few spooky things in the world of science.
units.displayText: Ahem! Anyway, there are quite a few spooky things in the world of science.

spans.text: Ahem! Anyway, there are quite a few spooky things in the world of science.

units.rawText: For instance, underground organizations creating zombies, quantum revenants struggling in the interstices of reality, the electronic sheep in the girls' dorm...

units.displayText: Eeeeek!!

units.displayText: That's enough, both of you. Professor, what do you make of all this?
